chapter: Instruments, first jobs and the regional scene
title: Why Toots Johnson's band was the one remembered
summary: Joe says Toots always had the best men, such as Buddy Petit.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Frankly, all the New Orleans musicians know about Toots Johnson's band, being in Baton Rouge. Why do you think they would have heard of Toots Johnson's band and not the other two bands that you mentioned?
Well, Toots Johnson always had the best men. Like I said, Toots Johnson had guys like Buddy Petit, and I think just before Guy Kelly left Baton Rouge he played with Toots Johnson.
